content.summary: A greenhouse messenger escapes giant roots, falls after a turn and visibly recovers. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One identity-locked adult follows a continuous route. + Repeated landmarks preserve pursuit geography. + Threat distance decreases across the route. + The fall occurs after a visible obstacle handoff. + Breath, brace and gaze visibly prove recovery.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow an original adult bicycle messenger running on foot through one narrow greenhouse service lane as giant flexible roots breach behind. Let the messenger reach a yellow corner rail and turn into the connected potting corridor. Use one breath, one hand brace and a focused upward gaze to prove recovery, then hold before renewed movement.
